text.arabic_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

words.gloss_range: connective particle joining the aftermath sign declaration to the preceding destruction narrative
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not let the ayah begin as a detached notice. It connects 51:37 to the destruction sequence in 51:35-36, while also reopening the scene as evidence left after judgment. Because the particle is proclitic, the connection runs straight into the leaving action; the reader hears preservation of a sign as continuous with the earlier removal, not as a separate appendix.

topics.headline: connected aftermath
topics.summary: The opening connector joins the sign declaration to the preceding destruction narrative.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that preservation of evidence belongs to the same narrative movement as destruction, not to a detached afterthought.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a conjunction, and the surrounding narrative makes the clause continue the prior destruction report while moving into evidence.

topics.headline: resumptive reframing
topics.summary: The connector can both coordinate backward and open a new aftermath beat.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a turn from event-report to evidence-report while the grammatical link to 51:35-36 remains active.
topics.reason: The particle's local function is compatible with coordination and resumptive continuation; neither value cancels the other in this boundary.

topics.headline: proclitic fusion
topics.summary: The connector is bound to the following perfect verb in script and recitation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connective force run directly into the action, so relation and leaving arrive as one opening movement.
topics.reason: The surface form prefixes the conjunction to the verb, matching the CRITICAL claim that the boundary link is visibly and audibly attached.

topics.headline: opening continuation frame
topics.summary: The ayah begins with a connective signal before the new action is parsed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader enters 51:37 looking back to the searched and judged place before reading the sign declaration.
topics.reason: The opening particle precedes the verb and makes the first structural signal connective rather than asyndetic.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person plural leaving that takes the sign as its explicit object in a destroyed location
words.root_gloss_range: root range of leaving, abandoning, letting remain, and what is left behind; locally narrowed to leaving a sign as preserved evidence, with inheritance language only a remnant-coloring pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَكْنَا}} ({{tr:taraknā}}) presents the sign-leaving as an accomplished divine act. The verb is not absolute: it takes the sign as its object, so the ruin is not just abandoned wreckage but a place where evidence has been left. The root pressure matters because abandonment and preservation meet here: the former habitation is left behind, yet what remains is curated as a readable sign. The same destruction-sign pattern appears at 29:35 and 54:15, and the perfect first-person ending also answers the prior finding in 51:36; the completed act launches a route from speaker to sign to recipients.

topics.headline: completed divine act
topics.summary: The perfect first-person plural form presents the leaving as an accomplished act by the continuing divine speaker.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is already placed by the same narrative speaker, while later reception remains open.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a perfect active 1cp verb with an implicit subject carried by the suffix, continuing the prior divine speaker role.

topics.headline: explicit sign object
topics.summary: The verb is locally transitive because the sign is the object that was left.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that what remains is not vague residue; the word governs a specific sign as its object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following sign noun as the direct object, so local valency selects a deliberate object-bearing leaving frame.

topics.headline: abandonment and preservation
topics.summary: The root range holds abandonment and leaving-to-remain together, with inheritance language only coloring the remnant idea.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ruined site as abandoned habitation and curated evidence at once; the bequest pressure makes the remnant future-facing without turning the word into a legal inheritance term.
topics.reason: V4 supports branches for letting go, leaving an effect to remain, and estate language, but local grammar selects leaving a sign in a place rather than a technical inheritance sense.

topics.headline: forensic formula
topics.summary: The verb joins a recurring destruction-sign frame also seen at 29:35 and 54:15.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a Quranic pattern in which destroyed places are converted into readable evidence, not merely remembered as scenes of loss.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallels at 29:35 and 54:15, and no guardrail evidence blocks treating them as formulaic comparison.

topics.headline: communication launch
topics.summary: The verb starts a sender-medium-receiver sequence before the audience is named.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the leaving action as the first step in routing a sign toward later recipients.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from the verb to the sign and then to the recipient phrase, so the action launches the communication structure.

topics.headline: boundary and cadence
topics.summary: The word carries the transition from prior finding to present leaving, with sound linking the act to the location.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated first-person perfect ending bind the prior finding to the current leaving, then hears the long-vowel cadence carry into the location.
topics.reason: The boundary rows compare the prior perfect first-person action with the current one, while the sound row notes the adjacent long-vowel link to the locative word.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition plus feminine suffix, placing the sign within the destroyed settlement or land
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَآ}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) keeps the evidence inside the judged place. The feminine suffix carries the destroyed settlement or land forward from the previous scene, while the containment sense makes the sign part of the site's condition rather than a marker beside it. Its position between the leaving verb and the sign-object matters: the reader reaches the sign only through the location, so the ruin itself becomes the medium of signification.

topics.headline: embedded location
topics.summary: The preposition marks containment inside the destroyed place rather than mere proximity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is embedded in the site itself, so the place becomes the medium of evidence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the phrase the locative complement of the leaving verb, and the CRITICAL rows contrast containment with surface or nearby relation.

topics.headline: feminine referent continuity
topics.summary: The suffix carries the destroyed settlement or land forward without renaming it.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the same judged location in view from 51:36 into the sign-bearing clause.
topics.reason: Attachment support identifies the suffix as a discourse-inferred feminine locative reference to the destroyed settlement.

topics.headline: fused locative hinge
topics.summary: Preposition and pronoun are fused, and the phrase stands between the verb and object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader must pass through place before reaching the sign, making location integral rather than appended.
topics.reason: The word compresses preposition and suffix, and its position before the direct object makes the locative phrase a hinge in the clause.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite sign, proof, marker, or readable trace left as the direct object of the leaving act
words.root_gloss_range: root evidence is missing from V4, so local sense is constrained by grammar and CRITICAL rows: sign, proof, marker, verse-resonance, and readable trace, with derivational alternatives kept only as pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَةًۭ}} ({{tr:āyatan}}) is the thing left: a direct object that mediates between the completed act and the later audience. Its singular indefiniteness keeps the sign pointed but open; the reader is not forced to choose only ruin, absence, trace, or the verse's own report. The word therefore works as physical marker and proof, while the verse-about-a-sign resonance remains visible. It also belongs to recurring ruined-place sign patterns at 29:35 and 54:15 and narrows the broader earth-sign field of 51:20 into one historical site; the comparison with 51:44 is only a wider warning-pattern contrast, not the same people.

topics.headline: object message
topics.summary: The sign is the object left by the verb and the medium routed toward recipients.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sign as the message that turns a completed divine act into something receivable by a defined audience.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the direct object, and the following lām phrase orients that object toward recipients.

topics.headline: indefinite singular openness
topics.summary: The singular indefinite form presents one sign without forcing a single fixed identification.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one pointed sign whose exact referent can include ruin, absence, trace, or the verse's own report without being flattened into any one option.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a singular indefinite accusative noun, and the CRITICAL rows tie tanwīn and singularity to bounded but open identification.

topics.headline: sign, proof, and trace
topics.summary: The word carries physical marker, proof, and verse resonance, while contested derivation remains only a pressure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the ruined place as readable proof and also hears the verse speak about a sign; the possible return-refuge derivation only adds mental-return pressure, not a new local root sense.
topics.reason: The local noun can function as sign and proof, but missing V4 rows for the root and the local form keep the derivational dispute from overriding the ordinary sign reading.

topics.headline: nominal sign form
topics.summary: The sign is presented as an encountered noun rather than as an action of signifying.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters signification as an object to be read, not as a verb describing an ongoing action.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence supports the root's Quranic realization as a nominal sign form, and no guardrail evidence contradicts this local noun function.

topics.headline: destruction-sign echoes
topics.summary: The sign belongs to recurring ruined-place and earth-sign patterns, with the 51:44 comparison limited to warning-pattern contrast.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this single Lot-site sign within wider Quranic sign fields at 29:35, 54:15, and 51:20, while not treating the Thamud scene at 51:44 as the same people.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels support a formulaic comparison, but the 51:44 row must be narrowed because 51:44 concerns Thamud rather than the same destroyed people as 51:37.

topics.headline: cadence to closure
topics.summary: The noun's open vowel cadence anticipates the ayah's final punishment phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the sign-object as part of the ayah's sound path toward the painful-punishment closure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows describe the noun's bounded recitation and its recurring open-vowel cadence toward the final adjective.

words.gloss_range: benefactive and purposive preposition directing the sign toward its effective recipients
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the sign from a mere object into something directed. Its force is benefactive and purposive: the sign is for a class of recipients and functions for them. That restriction should be read as effective reception, not as a claim that no one else could see the site. The fused recipient link also matters; the preposition tightens the movement from sign to audience inside the same declaration.

topics.headline: benefit and purpose
topics.summary: The preposition directs the sign toward the group introduced by the following relative pronoun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is not merely left in a place; it is oriented for a recipient class and purpose.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following relative phrase as governed by the preposition and as the beneficiary group for the sign.

topics.headline: effective recipient restriction
topics.summary: The lām restricts effective reception without denying that the ruins may be seen by others.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes physical availability from beneficial readability: the sign is effectively for those characterized by fear.
topics.reason: The exclusivity claim is narrowed because the grammar marks the sign's beneficiary or purpose, while the broader scene need not imply that no one else can observe the ruins.

topics.headline: fused recipient link
topics.summary: The preposition is graphically and audibly fused into the recipient phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the direction toward recipients tighten before the recipients are described.
topics.reason: The surface form compresses preposition and relative pronoun onset, matching the sound and form rows.

topics.headline: same-clause audience selection
topics.summary: The recipient phrase remains inside the sign declaration rather than becoming a separate comment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees audience selection as part of the sign's construction, not as an explanatory add-on.
topics.reason: The postposed prepositional phrase attaches to the sign declaration and completes the sender-medium-receiver sequence.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun introducing the audience-defining clause
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the audience a class defined by what follows. The sign is not assigned to a named people here; the relative construction turns the coming act of fearing into identity. It also supplies the subject-domain for the following imperfect verb, so the fear is not unattached anxiety. Because the pronoun is absorbed into the prepositional recipient phrase, audience selection is already underway before the verb states the condition.

topics.headline: relative class filter
topics.summary: The relative pronoun identifies the audience by the clause that follows.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipients are classified by a behavioral response, not by name, tribe, or place.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a masculine plural relative pronoun, and the following verb supplies the defining content of the class.

topics.headline: verb subject domain
topics.summary: The relative pronoun supplies the subject domain for the imperfect verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not read the following fear verb as an unattached generic action; it belongs to the defined recipient group.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence says the subject of the following verb is syntactically controlled by the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: selective perception
topics.summary: The construction restricts useful reception of the sign to those who fear.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah shift from the sign's existence to the condition under which it can be decoded.
topics.reason: The sequence governed by the preceding preposition forms the audience beat and limits the sign's useful address to the relative clause.

topics.headline: prepositional absorption
topics.summary: The pronoun is visually and phonologically absorbed into the preceding prepositional phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the audience marker as already governed before its defining verb appears.
topics.reason: Although tokenized separately, the surface phrase fuses the relative pronoun into the prepositional recipient construction.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural fear directed at the explicit punishment object, defining the sign's effective audience
words.root_gloss_range: root range of fear, dread, apprehensive anticipation, warning, and secondary diminution; locally selected as ongoing fearful anticipation of punishment, with diminution only as image pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَخَافُونَ}} ({{tr:yakhāfūna}}) defines the recipients by ongoing collective fear. Unlike the completed leaving, this imperfect action remains repeatable whenever the sign is encountered. The verb is also transitive here: fear is aimed at the punishment phrase, so the audience is not anxious in general but threat-aware toward a named consequence. The root's diminution branch only colors the pressure of anticipation; it does not replace the local fear sense. The profile echoes 70:27-28 as a punishment-fearing audience and also shifts the fear root from narrative reaction in 51:28 into warning reception here.

topics.headline: ongoing collective fear
topics.summary: The imperfect plural verb defines recipients by continuing fear rather than by a completed event or static noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign remains receivable across time because the qualifying fear is ongoing and collective.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect 3mp verb, and the CRITICAL rows contrast it with the completed leaving act and with static fear-noun expression.

topics.headline: explicit punishment object
topics.summary: The verb takes the punishment phrase as its explicit object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fear aimed at a named punitive outcome, not left as general anxiety.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following punishment noun as the direct object of the fear verb.

topics.headline: relative-clause filter
topics.summary: The verb completes the relative clause that makes the audience meaningful.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the audience filter become complete only when the relative pronoun, verb, and object operate together.
topics.reason: The verb's subject is controlled by the relative pronoun, and its object completes the behavior that qualifies the recipients.

topics.headline: threat-aware stance
topics.summary: The root names apprehensive awareness directed toward punishment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the recipients as people who correctly register the threat of punishment before it arrives.
topics.reason: V4 supports the local branch of fearful anticipation of harm, and the explicit object selects threat-awareness rather than surprise or awe in general.

topics.headline: gradual erosion pressure
topics.summary: A non-surface derivative adds wearing-down color but does not replace the local fear sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel anticipation as wearing pressure over time, while the local verb still means fearing, not literally diminishing something.
topics.reason: V4 lists a distinct diminishing branch, but the local Form I imperfect with a punishment object selects fear; the derivative only contributes secondary image pressure.

topics.headline: echoed audience profile
topics.summary: The fear of punishment matches broader Quranic audience profiles, including 70:27-28 and an earlier fear root in 51:28.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the local recipients as a known type: people whose response to punishment warning makes them able to benefit from signs.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete parallels at 70:27-28 and 51:28, and they function as comparison rather than as control over the local parse.

topics.headline: sound binding to object
topics.summary: The long-vowel cadence links the fear verb to its object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the act of fearing move directly into the punishment object while the discourse shifts from saved identity to active response.
topics.reason: The sound row and convergence row support a close fear-object sequence, while boundary rows show the move from prior identity language into ongoing qualification.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative punishment as the explicit object feared and as the noun qualified by the final adjective
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes sweet freshness, withholding, and torment; locally narrowed to definite imposed punishment, with sweet-water polarity only contrastive pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابَ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhāba}}) gives fear its concrete object. Its definiteness points to a known punitive category already activated by the destruction narrative, and its verbal-noun shape makes the feared thing a sustained imposed consequence rather than a single blow. The noun also waits for the final adjective: the punishment is grammatically and formulaically sealed as painful. The root's sweet-water polarity can sharpen the adverse contrast, but the local sense is punishment. Against 51:13-14, the warning arc moves from punishment experienced to punishment feared.

topics.headline: definite fear object
topics.summary: The punishment is the direct object of fear and is definite as a known punitive category.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fear land on a specific known punishment, not on danger in the abstract.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as the object of the fear verb, and QAC identifies it as definite accusative.

topics.headline: sanction process
topics.summary: The word names morally charged punishment as an imposed consequence and verbal-noun process.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the object of fear as juridical sanction and sustained consequence, not mere pain or loss.
topics.reason: The GERUND form and semantic rows support punishment as a process or state of punishing, while local context supplies wrongdoing-sanction valence.

topics.headline: adjective-sealed formula
topics.summary: The noun prepares and binds the final pain adjective in a stable punishment formula.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the punishment noun as incomplete until painfulness seals it into a recognized formula.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence says the final adjective modifies this noun, and co-occurrence rows support a strong punishment-pain pairing.

topics.headline: root polarity pressure
topics.summary: The sweet-water branch creates contrastive pressure but is not the local sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may feel punishment as the adverse counterpart to relief or sweetness, while the local noun still means punishment.
topics.reason: V4 lists sweet palatability as a separate branch and torment as the locally selected branch; the nonlocal branch can color contrast but cannot govern the local meaning.

topics.headline: warning arc and sound
topics.summary: The word participates in sign-punishment warning patterns and in the ayah's heavy sound closure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears punishment vocabulary shift the discourse from who escaped to what later readers must fear, with 51:13-14 as an earlier punishment-warning touchpoint.
topics.reason: The rows link sign and punishment fields, compare 51:13-14 with 51:37, and note the word's heavy consonantal texture.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative qualitative adjective agreeing with punishment and specifying its painful quality
words.root_gloss_range: root range is constrained locally to pain, painfulness, and pain-causing quality; speculative knowledge overlap is rejected for this adjective
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَلِيمَ}} ({{tr:al-alīma}}) seals the ayah by locking painfulness to the punishment already governed by fear. Its accusative agreement prevents a detached predicate, and its qualitative pattern lets the phrase say that the punishment is both pain-causing and pain-characterized. The word is also formulaic: it completes the familiar punishment-pain unit and leaves the final impression on felt suffering. The radical-overlap claim with knowledge is rejected because the local form and attachment make a pain adjective, not a knowledge term.

topics.headline: agreement lock
topics.summary: Case and definiteness keep the adjective inside the punishment phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word qualify the feared punishment rather than begin a new predication.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as an adjective agreeing with the punishment noun, and QAC identifies accusative definite agreement.

topics.headline: intensive pain quality
topics.summary: The qualitative adjective and pattern make the punishment pain-causing and pain-characterized.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the warning close on experienced painfulness, not merely on severity as a verdict.
topics.reason: The faʿīl-pattern rows support active and passive adjectival force, and the semantic rows specify deeply felt pain.

topics.headline: formulaic pain descriptor
topics.summary: The root's Quranic function is concentrated in this adjective as the expected punishment descriptor.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the ending as a familiar punishment formula rather than an improvised synonym for severity.
topics.reason: Distribution and co-occurrence rows show the adjective strongly paired with the punishment noun in a recurring formula.

topics.headline: closure cadence
topics.summary: The final adjective completes the relative clause and leaves pain as the ayah's closing impression.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah resolve only when the punishment has been named and qualified, with pain as the final semantic and rhythmic landing.
topics.reason: The structural rows place the word at clause closure, and the sound rows describe the cadence that seals the noun-adjective pair.

topics.headline: pain-knowledge overread
topics.summary: Shared radicals with another root do not license a knowledge meaning here.
topics.blocking_evidence: The local form and attachment make a pain adjective; radical overlap with a different root is not sufficient evidence for a knowledge meaning.
topics.reason: The local root is pain-related and the word is an adjective modifying punishment; overlapping radicals with another root do not activate a knowledge sense in this form.

baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate leaving preserves an aftermath as a visible indicator; that indicator lets a later observer infer a still-relevant painful outcome and therefore fear it.

activation_trace.role: A kept aftermath makes the sign an intentionally persisting residue rather than an accidental survival.
A manifest marker gives the retained residue its evidentiary form.
Expectation of harm from an indicator supplies the observer-side inference generated by the sign.
Punitive injury identifies the feared outcome to which the residue points.
Pain-inflicting force intensifies the prospective consequence encoded by the warning.

changed_reading.before: A generic warning sign was left at the place.
changed_reading.after: An aftermath was intentionally preserved as evidence from which later observers can project a painful consequence onto their own future.

baseline_models.mechanism: The leaving construction can describe ending an action with something in a resulting state, so the place is not merely abandoned with a sign inside it; the completed action renders what remains sign-like.

activation_trace.role: Leaving something in a resulting condition supplies the transition by which the aftermath becomes a sign.
Visible mark is the resulting condition imposed on the spatial remainder.

changed_reading.before: A pre-existing sign happened to remain in the location.
changed_reading.after: The terminal act itself leaves the location in the condition of being legible as a sign.

baseline_models.mechanism: The direct punitive sense remains controlling, but adjacent branches of ع ذ ب add a secondary contour of abstention and enforced withholding: painful punishment may be experienced not only as applied injury but as being cut off from what sustains or satisfies.

activation_trace.role: The direct punishment branch controls the reading and prevents the exploratory resonance from replacing the surface sense.
A body refraining from food and drink contributes an abstention-shaped mode of suffering.
Withholding and weaning supply deprivation as a possible functional component of punishment.
Painful effect keeps the deprivation contour attached to actual affliction.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is imagined only as pain actively imposed.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing that sense, the focus branches permit punishment also to carry the pain of enforced abstention and withheld sustenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier episode stages fear arising inwardly before unrecognized visitors, then cancels it by speech and reverses the surface toward gladness. The focus instead retains fear whose object is specified as painful punishment and whose warrant is a sign. Fear is thus calibrated by what the evidence actually indicates, not praised indiscriminately.

activation_trace.role: Failure of recognition supplies the epistemic deficit from which the first fear arises.
Fear falling into the interior locates the first response as an unverified inward apprehension.
Expected harm links the felt fear and its prohibition, showing that this expectation can be corrected.
News that opens the complexion with joy supplies the explicit reversal of the first fear.
A manifest indicator gives the final fear an external warrant.
Expectation of the specified punishment becomes the warranted counterpart to the earlier corrected expectation.

structural_cues: 51:28 moves from خِيفَةً through the imperative لَا تَخَفْ to glad tidings, whereas 51:37 predicates continuing fear of a specified punishment in a defined audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two fear episodes, cancellation and glad tidings in the first, and sign plus specified punishment in the second; I infer that evidence and object sort misdirected from warranted fear. A live alternative is that the two fears characterize unrelated audiences without a calibration contrast.

changed_reading.before: Those who fear are simply people possessing a valued fearful disposition.
changed_reading.after: They are readers whose fear has been correctly aimed by a legible indicator at a specified consequence, unlike the earlier fear that speech removes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope opens by making a renewed report come to the addressee and closes by leaving a sign. The report is a transport mechanism that repeatedly brings the retained evidence into a new reader's present, so the sign's persistence is textual as well as spatial.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival make the past event reach a presently addressed hearer.
Renewed speech as report supplies the repeatable carrier of the event.
Disclosure gives the arriving report the function of exposing what the residue means.
Preserved aftermath supplies the durable content that can be reactivated.
The manifest marker is what the arriving report makes newly present to interpretation.

structural_cues: The interrogative frame هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ begins the unit, while وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا ءَايَةً closes it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an arriving report at the opening and a retained sign at the close; I supply the arrow that narration reactivates spatial evidence for remote hearers. The report may alternatively be only a frame, with the sign restricted to a physical remnant.

changed_reading.before: The sign is a mute relic available only to someone at the location.
changed_reading.after: The retained relic is repeatedly made present when its report arrives, so narrative transmission participates in the sign's endurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A directed dispatch carries hard clay objects that are themselves marked and assigned to limit-crossers; after the action, a visible mark is left in the same place. The focus sign can therefore be read as the public, durable afterlife of a prior object-level marking operation.

activation_trace.role: Directed dispatch supplies movement of the punitive payload toward its recipients.
Hard stone gives the dispatched marks a durable material carrier.
Mixed clay specifies the payload's worked earthly material.
A conspicuous brand makes each punitive object legible as assigned rather than random.
The non-dominant mapped branch independently contributes a recognition mark, preserving the split root's convergent evidence.
Exceeding a limit identifies the recipients and makes the marking operation morally discriminating.
A preserved aftermath transfers the short-lived assignment into a durable public residue.
The visible sign is the aggregate legibility produced after the marked payload has acted.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from sending, to stones, to clay, to passive marking and specified recipients, then through evacuation to leaving a sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatched clay stones, their marking, their recipients, and a later retained sign; I infer transfer from marks on the payload to marked aftermath. A live alternative is that the final sign is a separate remnant with no material continuity to the stones.

changed_reading.before: The sign is an undifferentiated relic of destruction.
changed_reading.after: It is the public residue of a directed marking process: assigned marks act on particular recipients and leave the whole site legible afterward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence evacuates protected persons, inventories only one household, then leaves a sign in the repeatedly named space. Extraction and exception shape an absence, so the sign may consist not only in surviving matter but in the spatial difference produced by selective removal.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies the subtractive operation performed on the place.
Security and settled trust identify the class selectively removed from exposure.
Finding supplies an inspection of what the extraction leaves available to count.
Exception and exclusion compress the protected presence to a single remainder.
Household turns the counted remainder into a social unit, not merely a building.
Freedom from harm characterizes the lone household against the exposed place.
Vacating and leaving supplies the complementary operation to bringing the protected people out.
A visible indicator makes the selectively emptied spatial field readable.

structural_cues: The same locative فِيهَا recurs in 51:35, 51:36, and 51:37 under the first-person plural verbs أَخْرَجْنَا, وَجَدْنَا, and تَرَكْنَا.
The progression from whoever was in it, to no other than one house, to a sign narrows living presence into evidentiary remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evacuation, inspection, a one-house exception, repeated location, and a left sign; I supply the arrow that subtraction itself produces legibility. A live alternative is that an independent physical object alone constitutes the sign.

changed_reading.before: The sign is a positive object deposited among ruins.
changed_reading.after: The sign is also negative space: selective extraction, the lone protected household, and the emptied location jointly make the outcome readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence first presents food and registers non-eating, then replaces offered nourishment with an inedible mineral payload. This gives the focus punishment's withholding and abstention branches a concrete narrative contrast, while its direct punitive branch remains primary.

activation_trace.role: Taking food supplies the nourishment action whose non-occurrence is foregrounded by the question.
Hard stone replaces edible material with an injurious and inassimilable payload.
Clay reinforces the material reversal from prepared food to earth-made punishment.
Direct punitive injury remains the controlling endpoint of the material reversal.
Abstention from food and drink receives contextual support from the explicitly uneaten offering.
Withholding and weaning convert the food contrast into a secondary deprivation mechanism.

structural_cues: The hospitality sequence culminates in أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ, whereas the mission sequence culminates in stones made from clay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an uneaten offering, a later mineral payload, and punishment branches for pain, abstention, and withholding; I infer a food-to-stone reversal that materializes deprivation. changed_reading.before: The abstention and withholding branches were only remote lexical resonances inside the focus.
changed_reading.after: The movement from uneaten nourishment to injurious clay gives those resonances a visible narrative mechanism, though they remain subordinate to punishment's direct sense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the aftermath as a sealed verdict is surprising because it links a clay-seal branch to the marked stones and the final sign. It remains anchored in the clay material, explicit marking, judgment vocabulary, and the resultative leaving of a sign; downstream prose should call this a material analogy, not claim that the stones literally function as documentary seals.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treating the sign as a prospective boundary marker is less direct than treating it as retrospective evidence, because it activates the preventive branch of stone. It remains validly anchored in stone, explicit limit-crossers, marking, fear from an indicator, and the focus sign; downstream prose should present prevention as a function the residue acquires for readers, not as the lexical meaning of every stone.

activation_trace.role: Prevention and enclosure let the punitive material function analogically as a hard limit.

changed_reading.before: The sign only reports where a past limit was crossed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The anti-inheritance reading is surprising because it activates the estate-after-death branch of ت ر ك and compares two household futures. It remains anchored in the promised boy to an aged barren woman, cutting language around the criminal collective, the single household, and the sign left afterward; downstream prose should frame this as a pericope-level contrast, not a claim that ءَايَةً grammatically means inheritance.

activation_trace.role: Youth supplies living futurity for the first household.

changed_reading.before: The sign is simply what survives a destroyed population.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pericope contrasts living inheritance granted to an apparently closed household with an anti-inheritance left by a cut-off collective: its durable offspring is only a warning sign.

strongest_changes: The marked clay payload and the final sign form a transfer from assigned object-level marks to a durable public aftermath.
The repeated in-it sequence makes selective extraction, the lone household, and spatial absence part of the sign's evidence.
The earlier canceled fear revises the final fear into an evidence-calibrated response rather than an undifferentiated disposition.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became legible as an operation rather than a static relic: marks are dispatched, a population is selectively subtracted, the place is left in a sign-bearing state, and a transmitted report reactivates it. Split س و م mappings converged without being collapsed, while the clay-seal, boundary, deprivation, and anti-inheritance readings preserved branch-distant surprise under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The final sign may be materially continuous with the marked stones, or may be an independent remnant produced by the event.
Negative space and the emptied household may constitute the sign, or may only sharpen how a separate visible object is read.
The deprivation, seal, boundary, and inheritance contours are abductive branch activations and should not displace the direct senses of punishment, clay, stone, sign, or leaving.

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan dal, kaynak ifadesindeki ettirgen çekirdeği doğru verir: bir başkasına korku vermek, bir kişi ya da şeyi korkulur hale getirmek ve korku yoluyla sakınmaya yöneltmek. Korkuyu yaşayan kişi ile korkuyu doğuran kişi, nesne veya durum arasındaki yön farkı korunmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal korkunun meydana getirilmesini kapsar; kişinin kendi korkusu ve iki kişinin korkuda birbirini geçmesi bu ettirgen anlamdan ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel korkutma çekirdeği ile korkulan yol ve korku yoluyla sakındırma gibi söz öbeğine bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; bu özel kullanımlar yalın eylemin bütün kapsamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi, nesne veya durumun başkasında korku doğurması ya da bir kişi veya şeyi insanların korkacağı hale getirmesidir. Bu korku, kimi bağlamlarda muhatabı sakınmaya ve önlem almaya yöneltir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, nesne veya durum başka birinde korku doğurur.
Bir kişi ya da şey, insanların ondan korkacağı bir duruma getirilir veya öyle nitelenir.
Korku uyandırma, muhatabı sakınmaya ve önlem almaya yöneltmek için kullanılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar başkasında korku doğurma üzerinde birleşir. Ortak anlatım, korkutucu nitelik taşıyan kişi, nesne ve yolları da kapsar; ayrıca korkunun sakınmaya yönelten bir uyarı işlevi görebileceğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: korku doğurma ya da korkulur kılma

error_profile.loses: Korkutucu nesne ve yolları, ayrıca kendiliğinden korku doğuran durumları kapsamaz.
error_profile.adds: Kasıtlı bir zarar bildirimi veya güç gösterisi bulunduğu izlenimini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sözlü ya da davranışsal yıldırma anlamıyla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de suyun zorlanmadan içilmesini ve damakta hoş olmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında belirleyici eksen tatlılık ve tuzlu olmamadır; komşuda ise berraklıktan doğan içim kolaylığı öne çıkar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tatlı su ve berrak içme suyu adayları sınırı en iyi gösterdiği için yayımlandı, ötekiler örnek, uzak alan veya aynı kökün ayrı dalıdır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الماء العذب الطيب والمستساغ من طعام أو شراب، والاستعذاب بمعنى طلب الماء العذب أو عده عذبا، وما ألحقته المصادر بالريق والخمر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العذاب والعقوبة، ولا الامتناع عن الأكل والشرب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: عذب الماء عذوبة فهو عذب طيب (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib)؛ العذب ضد الملح وكل مستسيغ من طعام أو شراب (jamhara)؛ ماء عذب طيب بارد (mufradat)؛ استعذب القوم ماءهم إذا استقوه عذبا (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade hayvan ya da insanın yemeden ve içmeden durduğu bir hali açıkça bildirir. Şiddetli susuzluk sık bir neden olsa da tüm tanıklarda zorunlu değildir; bu yüzden hal, açlık duygusuna veya dinî oruca indirgenmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal başkasını engellemekten değil, kişinin veya hayvanın fiilen yemeyip içmemesinden söz eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, hal bildiren biçimleri ve hayvanın, insanın ya da gecenin özne olduğu belirli yapıları ayırarak birlikte kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın veya hayvanın, çoğu kez şiddetli susuzluk yüzünden, hiçbir şey yemeden ve içmeden durmasıdır. Bu hal bir gece boyunca sürme veya yemek karşısında belirsiz bir ara durumda kalma biçiminde de anlatılır.

facets.statement: İnsan veya hayvan fiilen yiyecek ve içecek tüketmeden durur.
Hayvanda yememenin nedeni özellikle şiddetli susuzluk olabilir.
Hal, geceyi hiçbir şey yemeden ve içmeden geçirmek biçiminde anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, insan veya hayvanın yemeyip içmediği hali ortaklaştırır; şiddetli susuzluk bunun belirgin fakat her kullanım için zorunlu olmayan nedenidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın tüketmeme halini, nedeni ve süresi ayrıca belirtilebilen genel bir karşılıkla verir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem yememeyi hem içmemeyi ve bunun süren bir hal oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Şiddetli susuzluk yüzünden yemeyen hayvanın anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Susuzluğun yol açtığı yememe durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: İçmeme bileşenini ve neden belirtilmeyen kullanımları açıkça söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tüketmeme halinin gece boyunca sürdüğünü anlatan yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yememeyi, içmemeyi ve gece boyunca sürmeyi birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, hayvanda susuzluktan doğabilen ve amaç ya da kural gerektirmeyen bir tüketmeme halini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, amaçlı veya kurallı perhizde yiyecek ve içecek dışındaki yasaklardan da kaçınmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da belirli bir süre yiyecek ve içecekten uzak durma vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bir canlıda gözlenen yememe-içmeme halidir; komşu ise iradeli veya kurallı bir kaçınma uygulamasını ve daha geniş yasak alanını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, içmemeyi ve özellikle susuzluğun yemeyi durdurduğu hayvan davranışını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, boş midenin yarattığı açlık duyusunu ve aç kişi halini merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yiyecek tüketilmemesiyle bağlantılı bedensel bir durumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Açlık mide boşluğu ve duyumdur; odak ise açlık duyulsun ya da duyulmasın, yememe ve içmeme davranışının sürmesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, belirli bir nesneye yönelik iradeli vazgeçiş olmadan da görülen bedensel tüketmeme halidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, herhangi bir işten vazgeçmeyi veya başkasını o işten alıkoymayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yemekten uzak durma bağlamında iki dal yüzeyde birbirine yaklaşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak sonucu oluşan yeme-içmeme halini adlandırır; komşu ise yönelinen şeyden çekilme veya birini çekme işlemini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; oruç, açlık ve aynı kökün alıkoyma dalı en olası karışmaları gösterir, öteki adaylar neden, sonuç veya daha uzak bedensel alanlardır.
branches.branch_image_ar: العذوب امتناع الجسد عن الأكل والشرب
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه عذوب الحمار أو الفرس أو الرجل إذا لم يأكل ولم يشرب، خاصة من شدة العطش أو بوصف قائم لا يذوق شيئا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس منع الغير عن الشيء ولا العذاب بمعنى العقوبة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: عذب الحمار يعذب عذبا وعذوبا فهو عاذب وعذوب لا يأكل من شدة العطش (maqayis;ayn)؛ العذوب من الدواب وغيرها القائم الذي لا يأكل ولا يشرب (sihah)؛ بات عذوبا إذا لم يأكل شيئا ولم يشرب (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade hem öznenin bir şeyden vazgeçmesini hem de bir başkasını ondan alıkoymasını açıkça bir araya getirir. Bir işten kesme ve sütten kesmeye benzetilen uzaklaştırma bu yön değişiminin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tüketmeme halini değil bir hedefe yönelişin kesilmesini veya kestirilmesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam belirli edatlı ve ettirgen yapılara bağlıdır; öznenin vazgeçmesi ile başkasını alıkoyması tanımda ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyden vazgeçip ona yönelmeyi bırakmak veya bir başkasını o şeyden uzak tutup alıkoymaktır. Sütten kesmeye benzer biçimde bir alışkanlığı ya da işi kestirmek bu ikinci yönün özel bir anlatımıdır.

facets.statement: Özne yöneldiği bir şeyden vazgeçer veya geri durur.
Bir kişi başkasını bir işten uzak tutar veya o işi ona bıraktırır.
Alıkoyma, birini bir işten sütten keser gibi kesme biçiminde anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, bir şeye yönelişi kesmektir; bu kesilme öznenin kendi vazgeçişi veya başka bir kişinin onu engellemesi biçiminde gerçekleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın dönüşlü ve ettirgen iki katılımcı düzenini kısa ve doğal biçimde birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kendi yönelişini kesme ile başkasının yönelişini kestirme ayrımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin bir konuyu veya davranışı kendi isteğiyle bıraktığı yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öznenin yöneldiği şeyden geri durmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiyi belirli bir işten uzak tuttuğu yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen katılımcı düzenini ve engellenen işi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, başkasını bir işten kesme ve sütten kesmeye benzer ettirgen alıkoyma kullanımını açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, geri çekilmenin yanında bir işi bir yana bırakma ve evde kalma gibi daha geniş uzak durma görünümlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeye yönelişi kesme, ondan geri durma veya onu bırakma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, belirli yapılarda kendi vazgeçişiyle başkasını alıkoymayı eşler; komşu daha genel geri çekilme ve yüz çevirme alanına yayılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, kişinin kendi isteğiyle vazgeçmesini ve kişisel bir ettirgen alıkoymayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, giriş, çıkış veya eylem üzerinde engel, yasak, görevli ve yaptırım gibi kurumsal sınırlar da kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişinin belirli bir eylemi yapmasını önleme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak yönelişin kesilmesine odaklanır; komşu ise fiziksel, hukuki veya kurumsal engel ve yasağı daha geniş bir çekirdek olarak taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel geri durma ile geniş engelleme alanları yayımlandı, daha dar tutma ve ayırma adayları bunlara göre yinelenen ya da uzak kaldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أعذب عن الشيء إذا تركه أو امتنع عنه، وأعذب غيره أو عذبه إذا منعه، والفطام عن أمر، وصيغة أعذبوا عن النساء في الذكر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس العذوبة في الماء، ولا العقوبة والإيجاع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أعذب عن الشيء إذا لها عنه وتركه (maqayis)؛ أعذب عن الشيء إذا امتنع عنه (jamhara;tahdhib)؛ أعذبته عن الأمر إذا منعته عنه (sihah)؛ عذبته تعذيبا كقولك فطمته عن هذا الأمر (ayn;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, bir varlık ile gökyüzü arasında hiçbir örtü bulunmamasını doğrudan bildirir. Aynı biçimlerin yememe-içmeme dalında da bulunması bu mekânsal anlamı değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel çıplaklıktan daha dardır: belirleyici koşul, varlıkla gökyüzü arasındaki üst örtünün yokluğudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın durum bildiren biçimler ile geceyi gökyüzüne açık geçirme yapısı aynı mekânsal çekirdek altında, yapı sınırları korunarak verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın kendisiyle gökyüzü arasında hiçbir dam, örtü veya siper bulunmadan açıkta kalmasıdır.

facets.statement: Varlık ile gökyüzü arasında onu örten hiçbir engel bulunmaz.
Bu durum geceyi gökyüzüne açık ve örtüsüz geçirme örneğiyle anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, gökyüzüyle kişi veya nesne arasında örtü bulunmayan açıkta kalma durumunda birleşir ve bunu geceleme örneğiyle gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üstünde hiçbir örtü olmadan doğrudan gökyüzüne açık kalan kişi veya nesne için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gökyüzü yönünü ve aradaki örtünün bütünüyle yokluğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin geceyi üstünde dam veya örtü bulunmadan geçirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geceleme olayını ve gökyüzüne açık kalmayı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak özellikle üst örtünün yokluğunu ve gökyüzüne doğrudan açık olmayı şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu giysisizliği, genel örtüsüzlüğü, açık araziyi ve eyersiz hayvanı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir varlığı örten veya gizleyen bir katmanın bulunmaması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dikey olarak gökyüzüne açık kalma durumudur; komşu beden, yer ve hayvan üzerinde çok daha genel bir örtüsüzlük alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, yerdeki genişlikten bağımsız olarak bir varlığın üstünde örtü bulunmamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, geniş ve açık bir alanı ve kişinin o alana çıkmasını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Açık gökyüzü altında bulunma sahnesinde iki dal birlikte gerçekleşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak kişinin veya nesnenin örtüsüz durumudur; komşu ise bulunulan yerin geniş ve açık oluşunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel örtüsüzlük ile açık alan adayları sınırı en iyi gösterdi, öteki adaylar belirli yüzeyler, görünürlük veya uzak mekân ilişkileridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العذوب أو العاذب الذي لا ستر بينه وبين السماء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد الامتناع عن الطعام والشراب إلا حيث احتملته الشواهد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العذوب الذي ليس بينه وبين السماء ستر وكذلك العاذب (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ فبات عذوبا للسماء كأنه سهيل (maqayis;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade ağır acı verme ve cezalandırma çekirdeğini doğrular. Bunun dayaktan türediği ve sonra her ağır sıkıntıya aktarıldığı açıklaması ortak zorunlu anlam değil, bildirilen bir köken ve genişleme görüşüdür; dal ancak bu kayıtla kabul edilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek ağır acı çektirme veya cezadır; her güçlük kendiliğinden bu dala girmez ve bildirilen dayak kökeni tanımın şartı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ad, eylem ve yok etmeye yönelik ceza yapısını ayırır; yapıya bağlı özel ceza bütün dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Birine ağır acı çektirme veya onu ağır biçimde cezalandırmadır. Dayak kökeni ve anlamın her türlü ağır sıkıntıya yayılması, çekirdeğin parçası değil aktarılan bir açıklamadır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ağır acı verilir veya ağır bir ceza uygulanır.
Belirli bir yapı, bütünüyle yok etmeye yönelik cezayı anlatır.
Bildirilen bir görüş anlamı dayaktan başlatır ve sonra her ağır sıkıntıya genişletir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek ağır acı verme ve cezalandırmadır; dayak kökeni ile her ağır sıkıntıya yayılma ise zorunlu anlamdan ayrı, aktarılan bir açıklamadır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem uygulanan ağır cezayı hem de birine şiddetli acı verme eylemini karşılayan çekirdek ifadedir.

error_profile.preserves: Ağır acı verme ile ceza uygulama bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eyleyenin başka bir kişiye şiddetli acı verdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyeni, etkileneni ve ağır acının verilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cezanın hedefi bütünüyle ortadan kaldırmak olduğunda kullanılan özel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Cezalandırmayı ve yok etmeye yönelik özel sonucu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, acı vermenin yanında ağır ceza uygulamayı ve cezayı ad olarak da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, bir şeyin veya kişinin acı verici olduğunu nitelemeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: acı verme veya acı verici olma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da başka bir kişide acı meydana getirme alanında doğrudan örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak ağır acı ve ceza eksenindedir; komşu ise şiddet veya ceza şartı olmadan acı verme eylemini ve acı verici niteliği kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, acının bir başkasına uygulanmasını ve bunun ceza niteliği taşımasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, acıyı yaşayan kişinin bedensel veya ruhsal duyumunu merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Uygulanan ağır acı, etkilenen kişide acı duyumuna yol açar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak acının uygulanması ve cezalandırma yönündedir; komşu ise etkilenen kişinin acıyı hissetmesi durumudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, birine ağır acı veya ceza uygulanmasını çekirdek edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, sınanma niteliğindeki sıkıntıların yanında rahatlığı ve mal ya da çocuklarla sınanmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ağır sıkıntı veya ceza, iki dalın kesiştiği deneyim alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta acı verme ve ceza vardır; komşuda belirleyici unsur iyi veya kötü bir durumun sınama işlevi görmesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; acı verme, acı duyma ve sınanma adayları temel sınırları gösterdi, diğerleri belirli ceza türleri veya daha uzak şiddet sahneleridir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العذاب والعقوبة والإيجاع الشديد، والتعذيب، وما يذكره المصدر من أصل الضرب ثم استعارة كل شدة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الماء العذب ولا طرف السوط المسمى عذبة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العذاب يقال منه عذب تعذيبا وناس يقولون أصل العذاب الضرب ثم استعير ذلك في كل شدة (maqayis)؛ عذبت الرجل وغيره تعذيبا والاسم العذاب (jamhara)؛ العذاب العقوبة وقد عذبته تعذيبا (sihah)؛ العذاب هو الإيجاع الشديد (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade kamçı ve dil ucu gibi uçları; mızrağa bağlanan bez, teraziyi kaldıran ip, ayakkabı bağı ucu ve dal gibi uzanan ya da sarkan parçaları birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu ortak biçimsel alanı doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyin ince ucu veya ona bağlı sarkan parçadır; su kirliliği, ceza ve hayvanın ayakları bu kapsama girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam çoğunlukla belirtilen nesneyle kurulan yapılara bağlıdır; uç, bağ, bez, ip ve dal gerçekleşmeleri tek bir yalın ada indirgenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin ince veya dışa uzanan ucu ya da ona bağlanıp sarkan ip, kayış, bez, deri veya dal parçasıdır. Belirli araç ve beden bölümlerinde parçanın yeri ve işlevi ayrıca belirlenir.

facets.statement: Kamçı veya dil gibi bir şeyin ince, dışa uzanan son bölümüdür.
Bir nesneye bağlanan veya ondan sarkan ip, kayış, bez ya da deri parçasıdır.
Ağaçta aynı biçimsel alan dışa uzanan dalı karşılar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar uçta bulunan veya bir şeye bağlanıp sarkan ince parçaları ortaklaştırır; kamçı, dil, mızrak, terazi, ağaç ve ayakkabı bağı bunun belirli gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: ince uç veya sarkan bağlı parça
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem doğal uçlarını hem de bir araca bağlanan ip, kayış, bez veya deri parçalarını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Uç konumunu, inceliği ve bağlı parçanın sarkma niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kamçının son bölümü ya da ona takılmış sarkan bağ anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kamçıya ait uç ve sarkan bağ seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayakkabı bağı, eyer veya başka bir kayışın serbestçe sarkan ucunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kayışa bağlı olmayı, uç konumunu ve sarkmayı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, uçların yanında mızrağa bağlanan bez, terazi ipi, dal ve sarkan kayış gibi bağlı parçaları da kapsar.
